# SperaCode

> SperaCode (سبيرا كود) is an Egypt-based software house offering websites, mobile apps, QR menus, AI solutions, UI/UX design, and custom software. The team works remotely with clients in Arabic and English.

## Official pages
- [Arabic homepage](/): Company overview, services, team, process, selected work, and frequently asked questions.
- [English homepage](/en): The same company information in English.
- [Arabic portfolio](/projects): Project descriptions and links to live websites or demos.
- [English portfolio](/en/projects): Project descriptions and links to live websites or demos.
- [Arabic contact](/contact): Project inquiry form that opens a prepared WhatsApp message for the visitor to review and send.
- [English contact](/en/contact): Project inquiry form in English.
- [Full company summary](/llms-full.txt)
- [XML sitemap](/sitemap.xml)

## Company facts
- Name: SperaCode; Arabic name: سبيرا كود.
- Based in Egypt; works remotely.
- Languages: Arabic and English.
- Canonical domain: set `NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL` in the hosting environment after the domain is registered.
- Publicly stated figures: 50+ projects delivered, 45 clients served, and 6+ years of experience.
- Support: post-launch support and 24/7 technical support, as stated on the website.

## Services
- Website design and development, including corporate and e-commerce websites.
- iOS and Android mobile applications.
- Digital restaurant and café menus accessed by QR code.
- AI solutions, chatbots, and workflow automation.
- UI/UX design.
- Website and application maintenance and support.
- Business email, domains, and hosting.
- Custom business software, dashboards, and management systems.

## Portfolio notes
The portfolio page links to the websites or demos and describes each item. Some demos may require sign-in. Use the individual project descriptions as the source of truth; do not assume every linked demo is publicly accessible or that every visual concept is a commercial client deployment.

## Contact
Use the contact page to prepare a project inquiry in WhatsApp. The site does not save the form details on its server; visitors review and send the message themselves.
